messages:
anya: noticing a ~2.4x jump in p95 latency on prod endpoints around 12:02 UTC after the model push. traffic same, infra unchanged. digging in.
kevin: which model version pushed? any tokenizer changes in that release?
anya: pushed model v3.1. it contains a new tokenizer merge (whitespace merge rule) — our seq-len distribution average moved from ~128 -> ~210. KV hit rate dropped ~15%. seeing more small batches.
luis: that seq shift could push kernel selector into a different codepath. we have a threshold: if median_seq > 160 choose "wide-kernel" else "narrow-kernel". maybe that flip caused throughput regression.
rachel: alerting: p95 for /generate is 420ms -> 1.05s. error rate steady, so it's perf only. rolling traces now.
anya: profiler snapshots attached (snip):
```
-- nvprof summary --
kernel: fast_attn_wide  68% GPU time
kernel: fast_attn_narrow 18% GPU time
smem stalls increased 2.3x
end-to-end CDF shift at token 0..10
```
kevin: interesting — selector picked fast_attn_wide more often which has higher throughput for long sequences but worse latency for small-batch asynchronous traffic. our batching heuristic doesn't account for increased variance in seq-lengths.
luis: also seeing KV cache miss surge correlating with tokenization changes — more unique prefixes because of different token boundaries. that raises per-request compute (cache warmups).
anya: hypothesis: tokenizer change increased avg seq len + reduced KV locality -> kernel misselection + smaller effective batch sizes -> higher p95.
maria: is rollback possible? customers noticing latency; recommend rollback to v3.0 while we fix.
kevin: we can hotfix selector to use weighted cost model rather than median threshold. cheap mitigation: temporarily force selector to prefer narrow kernel for tail latency sensitive endpoints.
anya: tried forcing selector to narrow on one shard: p95 dropped from 1.05s -> 480ms, throughput stable. KV miss still up but impact smaller.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled canary config change to prefer narrow-kernel for route /generate on shard-a at 1769235330 :thumbsup:
luis: longer-term: add seq-length histogram metric to runtime metrics and incorporate KV locality estimate into kernel scoring. also ask model team to revisit tokenizer change impact.
rachel: okay can we ship quick config and schedule rollback if regressions persist? Ops prefers rollback now, but dev says quick config bought time.
maria: do rollback to v3.0 for customer-facing clusters, keep canary config in internal cluster for experiments.
kevin: action items: 1) rapid rollback v3.0 to prod (rachel) 2) add seq-length histogram + KV-locality gauge (kevin) 3) update kernel selector to cost-based (luis) 4) follow-up with model team on tokenizer (anya)
anya: I'll open postmortem draft. initial root cause: tokenizer-induced seq-length distribution shift -> kernel selection threshold flip + KV locality drop -> tail latency regression. planning follow-up eval harness to simulate tokenization shifts.
maria: thanks everyone. please add any notes to the postmortem doc and include perf traces + nvprof output. :white_check_mark:
